claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k production-ready (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: LangDom=0.477, JP=0.735). Dense embeddings blocked at 129k/174k (74.5%) by missing parquet for 2020-2026 and bge_<->bger_ ID mapping. Two-mode tradeoff reproduced: Citation/Outcome JP~0.73 vs Semantic JP~0.05-0.37 vs Hybrid JP~0.54. No single representation dominates all metrics at any scale.
evidence_summary: 8 primary evidence artifacts independently verified across 5 factory direction v29 deliverables. TF-IDF 174k formal suite complete: all 8 representations PASS both adversarial gates at 173,963 decisions. Dense embedding assembly BLOCKED at 129,680/173,963 (74.5%, years 2000-2019); missing parquet/ID mapping for 2020-2026 (44,283 decisions). Center projected FAILS jurist gate at ALL scales (3yr JP=0.39-0.42, 15yr JP=0.288, 19yr JP=0.3685, 20yr JP=0.0475 catastrophic). Linear combinations PASS at 19yr (linear_hybrid05 JP=0.5395, linear_citation_concat JP=0.5445) but below TF-IDF baseline (JP=0.7235); 15yr FAIL (JP=0.473). Section cross-lingual at 1K sample: sachverhalt superior (cp_64 gap=0.187) vs erwaegungen (gap=0.452). v8 holdout zero-shot: all 4 TF-IDF hybrids PASS on true holdout, leakage minimal (LangDom +0.005, JP -0.015 to -0.020). Negative results reproduced: v18 coarse hierarchy best purity 0.65 < 0.7 threshold; boilerplate resistance scores -0.74 to -0.93 across all reps (proxy measures LangDom, not boilerplate); v17b label normalization regime-dependent at scale. No same-cycle repairable defects; blockers require corpus-lane coordination or Frontier team.
